1) Please send any infra diagrams and the technical contact (Ravi) so we can loop in SE.
2) I'll schedule a 60-min SE deep dive (architecture + config examples).
3) We can share a small sample of traffic after the SE call for tuning routing & batching settings.

Thanks everyone — quick technical plan to get the SE deep-dive started. High-level recommendations (we can expand during the call):

1) Auth & SDK
- PoC: server-side Redwood SDK + API key scoped to project (easy to setup).
- Prod: recommend short-lived tokens via OIDC (service account flow) + per-route key scoping.
- We will provide a code snippet for SDK init and token refresh during the SE call.

2) Model routing & policy (example)- Priority: ui-search -> low-latency model (e.g., rw-fast-v1), fallback -> high-quality model (rw-ctl-v1).
- Latency SLO: set target p95 300ms; route to fast model when estimated tokens/time < threshold.
- Cost policy: prefer quantized variants for bulk/batch.
- Region routing: prefer us-east-1; automatic region failover to us-west if capacity constrained.
- Fallback chain: rw-fast-v1 -> rw-ctl-v1 -> api-fallback (stateless CPU endpoint)

3) Structured output & tool-calling
- Use Redwood's tool-calling JSON schema validation to enforce ticket payloads.
- For external tool calls (e.g., Jira), prefer to run tool calls from a backend worker with authenticated service account (avoids exposing secrets client-side).

4) Embeddings & reranker
- Pipeline: query embeddings -> ANN candidate retrieval (FAISS/Annoy or managed index) -> reranker model for final scoring.
- Recommendation: run reranker inline when top-K small (K<=10) for accuracy; use async rerank for larger candidate sets.
- Suggest quantized embedding model for lower cost and a hybrid index for geo-redundancy.

5) Next steps
- I'll prepare a short YAML example showing a routing policy and a sample SDK snippet, and attach it here: [Attachment: redwood-routing-example.yaml (text/plain)].
- SE call: Tue 2026-08-18 10:00 PT works for me.

Cc'ing Marcus for any infra notes (proxies, NAT, VPC peering) we should call out.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
